name: Crostino with Roasted Tomatoes & Burrata
steps: Heat oven to 180°C. Toss cherry tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, a pinch of salt and 1 minced garlic clove in a small baking dish.
Roast tomatoes for 20–25 min until blistered and jammy.
Slice the bread and drizzle with remaining olive oil. Toast in a dry pan over medium heat 3–4 min per side until golden and crisp.
While still warm, rub the toast with the remaining whole garlic clove.
Tear burrata over the toast, spoon over the roasted tomatoes with all their juices.
Finish with fresh basil leaves and a pinch of sea salt flakes.
